question:
A business produces notebooks and pens. Each notebook requires 5 min printing, 2 min binding; each pen 3 min printing, 1 min binding. The company has 300 min printing and 120 min binding per day. Due to orders, at least 20 notebooks and 40 pens must be made daily. Each notebook yields ₹10 profit, each pen ₹5.

(a) Frame the LPP.

(b) Draw feasible region and find its vertices.

(c) Find optimum daily production for max profit and explain your answer.

options.A:
(a) Max $Z=10x+5y$ with $5x+3y\leq300$, $2x+y\leq120$, $x\geq20$, $y\geq40$
(b) Vertices: $(20,40)$, $(20,\frac{200}{3})$, $(36,40)$
(c) Optimum production: 20 notebooks and 40 pens; maximum profit ₹400.
options.B:
(a) Max $Z=10x+5y$ with $5x+3y\leq300$, $2x+y\leq120$, $x\geq20$, $y\geq40$
(b) Vertices: $(20,40)$, $(40,40)$, $(60,0)$
(c) Optimum production: 40 notebooks and 40 pens; maximum profit ₹600.
options.C:
(a) Max $Z=10x+5y$ with $5x+3y\leq300$, $2x+y\leq120$, $x\geq20$, $y\geq40$
(b) Vertices: $(20,40)$, $(20,\frac{200}{3})$, $(36,40)$
(c) Optimum production: 36 notebooks and 40 pens; maximum profit ₹560.
options.D:
(a) Max $Z=10x+5y$ with $5x+3y\leq300$, $2x+y\leq120$, $x\geq20$, $y\geq40$
(b) Vertices: $(20,40)$, $(20,60)$, $(40,40)$
(c) Optimum production: 20 notebooks and $\frac{200}{3}$ pens; maximum profit ₹533.35.
